name: polyread-web
description: PDF reader that speaks academic readings aloud with word-level highlighting. Runs entirely on your machine.

scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm run electron:build && electron .
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run electron:build && electron-builder
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run electron:build && electron-builder --linux
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run electron:build && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run electron:build && electron-builder --mac
